value.description: An industrial repair line that mends worn gear with no pawn labor. It always works as a skill 10 mender - never better, however good your crafters are - but that is its only limit: it will repair anything put in front of it, including gear your colony has no idea how to build. Select it to see its spots: it takes everything in on the side it faces - gear on the cyan port at the centre of that edge, materials either side of it and down both flanks - and finished items come out of the single port on the opposite edge. Put one damaged weapon or piece of apparel on the cyan spot, repair materials on any of the eight green spots, and collect repaired gear from the orange spot. Every spot accepts loose items on the ground or any storage building sitting on it. To run it off conveyors, build a factory hopper on a spot and point the belt at that - a belt aimed straight at the machine has nowhere to unload and will stall. Throws off serious heat while a repair is running, so it needs real cooling. Its waste container must be emptied when full, either by a hauler or with the dump command.
